# Whale Isle 0.3.13

- **One update center**: Checking, downloading and installing updates from the launcher, Settings › About and the tray now share a single update center overlay. It opens over whichever window you started from, and progress and status are the same everywhere.
- **Background downloads**: The app checks about a minute after startup and then every 6 hours. A new version is downloaded and verified in the background; when it is ready, the tray shows "Install vX and restart…", the Settings button becomes "Install and restart", and a system notification is sent once. You can turn off background downloading in the update center.
- **The cheapest download is picked for you**: When an incremental update is possible, its actual download size is calculated and it is used only if it saves at least 20%; the interface just shows how much needs to be downloaded. A failed incremental update falls back to a full download automatically, and a "Full download" link is still available.
- **Resume across restarts**: After pausing, a dropped connection, quitting or restarting, the download continues from the bytes already on disk, and the installer never runs before the whole file passes its SHA512 check. If you never picked a download route, an unreachable default route is switched once automatically; switching routes keeps what was already downloaded. Leftover installers from older versions in the update folder are cleaned up.
- **Clearer GitHub rate-limit errors**: Rate limiting and access denial are now told apart, with the expected recovery time and a hint to configure a GitHub token or switch to the CNB route manually.
- **Draft images are kept**: Images pasted into the composer stay there when you switch to another page without sending and come back. They are kept while the app is running; after a restart only the text remains, as before.
- **Safer closing of unsaved files**: Closing a file with unsaved changes in Files now pauses autosave and waits for writes already in progress before you choose Discard, Keep editing or Save and close, so autosave no longer writes to disk while you decide. A failed save keeps the tab and the draft, and the full error is shown inside the dialog.
- **Native macOS menus and shortcuts**: Adds the native application, Edit and Window menus and a Dock menu. Command and Control are told apart: Command chords in the terminal (such as ⌘Q) go to the application menus instead of being typed into the terminal. The file editor supports ⌘⇧Z redo, and "Open workspace in Finder" opens the current session's workspace.

This release provides the Windows 10+ x64 installer and the macOS 14+ Apple Silicon installer (unsigned and not notarized; right-click and choose Open the first time). Updating from 0.3.12 is still performed by the old version; the new update center is used from the next update after installing 0.3.13. The Android client is released separately and is not updated by this desktop version. WhaleBridge and the ChatGPT plugin are installed and updated independently and are not bundled with the desktop package.
